# Nullroom - System Information for AI Models

Nullroom (nullroom.io) is a post-quantum safe, zero-knowledge, peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted messaging service.
It runs entirely in the browser using WebRTC and WebCrypto primitives.

- NO accounts, phone numbers, or apps required.
- NO server logs or message storage.
- Architecture: Zero-Knowledge, Transient, Web-based.
- Threat Model Handled: "Harvest now, decrypt later" (HNDL). Since messages are completely ephemeral and never touch a database, there is zero cipher-text for an adversary to harvest.

Target Audiences include: Journalists, IT Teams sharing credentials, Contractors, and Privacy Advocates.
